verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's only power statement for the SXM part is that it delivers its claimed up-to-2X LLM inference speedup "within the same power profile as the H100." That implies better performance per watt, but it gives no explicit wattage figure. The lower-power, air-cooled claim applies to the separate H200 NVL SKU, not the SXM part. Missing for 10: a documented numeric power envelope (TDP/configurable power range) for H200 SXM, independent or hands-on performance-per-watt testing, and evidence on efficiency under sustained workloads.
